name: Shoujo no Michikusa ~Akiba Idol Ura Jijou~
original_name: 少女の道草～AKIBAアイドル裏事情 -闇堕ちアイドル裏営業- ～
source:
An Akihabara pop idol's shocking hidden side comes to light!

Akiba idols thrive on their innocent image.
That allure is what sells to fans: they seduce with purity, yet remain untouched.
This is the story of a scandalous reality, told with erotic realism.

Minori Ooba is one of Akiba's most popular group members.
To keep that popularity she's started to behave very un-idol-like.

Her behavior draws in the protagonist. Once he's in, there's no escape. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE105788.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
秋叶原流行偶像令人震惊的隐藏的一面曝光！

秋叶原偶像凭借其纯真的形象而蓬勃发展。
这种魅力正是卖给粉丝的东西：他们以纯洁的方式诱惑，但又保持原样。
这是一个以色情现实主义讲述的丑闻现实的故事。

Minori Ooba是秋叶原最受欢迎的团体成员之一。
为了保持这种受欢迎程度，她开始表现得非常不像偶像。

她的行为吸引了主角。一旦进来，就无处可逃。
